text:
Maya S.: quick sync — planning a header-based canary for response-streaming-v2. idea: SDKs >= 1.8 will send `x-rw-sdk-features: streaming=v2`. server chooses optimized path when header present. target: 10% web clients, 5% mobile clients. need checklist + any gotchas?

Rick P.: sounds good. main things: 1) header parsing in the edge layer (fast path), 2) ensure older SDKs that don't send header keep current behavior, 3) metrics/alerts for error-rate and latency regression.

Zane K.: question — how will we scope by sdk_version? header only, or also validate `x-rw-sdk-version`? some mobile clients might not include feature header yet.

Maya S.: plan is header + `x-rw-sdk-version` fallback. if header present => enable. else if version >= 1.8 => probabilistic canary (based on user_id hashing). else do not enable. keep server-side flag to force-enable for targeted QA users.

Liu: small nit — SDKs might send header with different ordering/spacing. parser should do `includes('streaming=v2')` not strict equality. e.g.:
```js
const feats = (req.headers['x-rw-sdk-features'] || '').split(',').map(s=>s.trim());
if (feats.includes('streaming=v2')) { enableStreamingV2(); }
```

Rick P.: add tests: unit for header parsing, e2e for older SDK (no header) to confirm unchanged response, and a perf test comparing token throughput. also add opt-out header `x-rw-features-optout: streaming` for internal debugging.

Maya S.: guardrails:
- abort and fallback if tail latency increases > 30% vs baseline for 5m window
- error-rate > 0.5% absolute increase -> rollback
- any 5xx for streaming path -> automatic fallback to v1 for that request

Zane K.: where should the rollout policy live? proposal: config in rollout service (same as other experiments) with fields: percent_web, percent_mobile, min_sdk_version, forced_users list. server edge does evaluation and adds a header `x-rw-rollout-source: canary-rollout/1767543210` for observability.

Liu: logging: emit `feature_gated` event with tags { feature: "streaming-v2", sdk_version, rollout_source } so analytics team can slice. Also add a health metric `streaming_v2_enabled_count` and `streaming_v2_errors`.

Rick P.: code review checklist: small middleware in edge repo (perf must be O(1) parse), integration test in api-gateway, e2e with mobile emulator, update SDK CHANGELOGs + telemetry change (send feature header only when enabled in client).

Maya S.: timeline proposal:
- today: PR for edge header parser & rollout evaluation (rick/zane review)
- +2 days: add tests & telemetry event (liu)
- +4 days: internal QA with forced_users list
- +6 days: gradual canary (10% web / 5% mobile) with 1hr hold per step and automated checks

Zane K.: I'll take the edge PR review. Rick can you own the rollout config and guardrail automation?

Rick P.: yep. I'll wire alerts in grafana and add the rollback job.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started for edge middleware at 1767543900 — canary nodes: 12/120 (10%) :rocket:

Liu: quick FYI — I'll add the `feature_gated` event to our analytics schema and notify data infra. expect schema change review in ~24h.

Maya S.: thanks all. post-merge checklist before canary: update SDK docs, add migration note in release channels, run perf baseline job. pinging @Zane, @Rick for final lgtm when PRs land. :thumbsup:

Zane K.: lgtm once tests green.

Rick P.: lgtm, will monitor the alerts.

deploy-bot: canary metrics update @ 1767544200 — latency delta: +3%, error rate: +0.02% (within thresholds).

Maya S.: holding for 1hr, then roll to 25% if stable. thanks everyone.
